SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-25-2025 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-25-2025 BY VISITING JUDGE TAMILA IPEMA. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF INES LEIFER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SWISS INTERNATIONAL AIR LINES LTD (INA LANTAYAN APPEARING IN ZOOM) IS PRESENT. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-25-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LEIFER, INES RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SWISS INTERNATIONAL AIR LINES LTD. AKA SWISS $3,341.41 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,391.41, THE COURT FINDS THAT PLAINTIFF HAS MET HER BURDEN OF PROOF. DEFENDANT UNREASONABLY AND WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION DENIED PLAINTIFF'S MEDICAL EMERGENCY IN CANCELING THE TRIP PRIOR TO THE SCHEDULED TRAVEL DATE PER HER REQUEST AFTER PROMISING HER THEY WOULD SO. THE COURT FINDS THAT PLAINTIFF WENT BEYOND THE CALL OF DUTY IN IN FOLLOWING ALL OF THE SWISS RULES TO CANCEL & PROVIDED THE SWISS RULES TO CANCEL & PROVIDED THE, WITH ALL REQUESTED DOCUMENTS PRIOR TO THE FLIGHT DEPARTURE. PLEASE SEE CONTINUATION OF JUDGMENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
